title: Manager, IT Business & Product Management
description:
**Our Digital Transformation**


The Coca Cola Company is evolving into a more digital first, data driven enterprise to fuel sustainable growth, increase speed to market, and unlock new sources of value. Rapid advances in technology, data, and AI create a unique opportunity to accelerate The Coca\-Cola Company (TCCC) system’s next chapter of growth by reimagining our core competitive advantages. Building on a strong foundation of modernized infrastructure, global digital experiences, early data capabilities, and proven use cases, we are now shifting from early wins to scaled, end to end impact on growth, productivity, and efficiency. This next phase moves us from an analog world to a fully digitized one, powered by a digital growth engine that embeds data, technology, and AI into our most critical business domains. Success will require more than technology implementation, it demands a strategic transformation of core capabilities, a domain based, product centric operating model, and a cultural shift toward experimentation, data and technology fluency, and seamless partnership between business and digital teams.

**Role Overview**


The **Manager, IT Business \& Product Management** will help connect business priorities with technology solutions that deliver measurable value in Manufacturing IT environment. This role acts as a trusted partner to business stakeholders, product teams, finance, architecture, delivery teams, vendors, and service providers. The role is responsible for translating business needs into product priorities, roadmaps, portfolio decisions, and technology outcomes, while supporting effective escalation management and value realization. This position is ideal for a business\-facing information technology professional who understands how to balance customer needs, operational priorities, workplace technology, manufacturing environments, vendor delivery, financial discipline, and digital transformation. The successful candidate will bring strong product management capability, practical technology fluency, excellent communication skills, and the ability to drive results in a cross\-functional manufacturing environment. This role helps ensuring technology products and services are aligned to business capability needs, governed effectively, and continuously improved through data, insight, and collaboration with business stakeholders, product teams, finance, architecture, delivery teams, and technology partners.

**What You will do for us**

* Lead business engagement by partnering with business stakeholders to understand priorities, pain points, operational needs, and opportunities for technology\-enabled improvement.
* Translate business requirements into product priorities, technology outcomes, roadmap plans, and investment recommendations that support measurable business value.
* Develop and manage product roadmaps aligned to business capability needs, portfolio priorities, operational readiness, and financial planning.
* Own product outcomes, adoption, user value, business impact, and product\-related escalations for assigned technology services or capabilities.
* Use governance, prioritization methods, and performance insights to improve product outcomes, business alignment, and decision\-making.
* Assess the business and product impact of incidents, ensuring appropriate stakeholder communication, escalation support, and alignment with vendors and technical resolution teams.
* Support change prioritization, release readiness, business adoption, governance decisions, and stakeholder alignment for technology changes.
* Support business capability development and digital product evolution through value\-based investment decisions and coordination across delivery, architecture, finance, and operations teams.
* Manage strategic technology partners, vendors, and service providers that support product delivery, roadmap execution, workplace technology, manufacturing solutions, or business outcomes.
* Coordinate with management teams, vendors, and service providers to resolve issues, support service quality, and improve delivery performance.
* Use business, product, adoption, financial, operational, and value realization metrics to determine priorities and influence portfolio decisions.
* Apply artificial intelligence insights and data\-driven analysis to support prioritization, product decisions, service improvement, and business value creation.
* Ensure product priorities and delivery decisions align with governance, risk, cybersecurity, compliance, and technology standards.
* Support business case development, investment planning, portfolio prioritization, value realization, and management of operating expense and capital expenditure budgets.
* Influence product portfolio priorities, business capability investment, and strategic technology planning within the relevant business and technology scope.
* Bring awareness of manufacturing systems and applications to support operational environments, business continuity, and practical technology decision\-making.

**Requirements and Qualifications Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or equivalent experience.
* 5\+ years of experience working in Information Technology, preferably in business\-facing technology, product management, workplace technology, manufacturing technology, service delivery, or a related environment.
* Practical knowledge of end\-user and workplace technology services, including personal computers, deskside support, Microsoft and Apple operating systems, remote desktop protocol, virtual desktop infrastructure, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Office, email, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams.
* Knowledge of output management solutions, including multifunction printers, secure print, label printers, and network printers.
* Familiarity with manufacturing systems, manufacturing applications, or technology used to support production or bottling environments.
* Experience in product management, business relationship management, roadmap planning, portfolio management, and agile delivery.
* Experience leading a team or workstream, motivating others, driving execution, and delivering results in a cross\-functional environment.
* Proven ability to develop information technology solutions that address complex business problems and enable measurable outcomes.
* Strong business partnership skills, including the ability to translate stakeholder needs into product priorities, technology requirements, and actionable plans.
* Experience coordinating with management, vendors, service providers, and technology partners to support delivery quality, service performance, and business outcomes.
* Strong understanding of technology governance, prioritization, change readiness, cybersecurity, compliance, risk management, and service management practices.
* Ability to use data, metrics, analytics, and financial indicators to guide prioritization, measure adoption, and support continuous improvement.
* Working knowledge of artificial intelligence and automation concepts, with the ability to apply insights appropriately to product management, decision\-making, and service improvement.
* Demonstrated financial acumen, including experience supporting business cases, investment planning, operating expense budgets, capital expenditure budgets, and value realization.
* Strong communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and escalation management skills, with the ability to engage effectively across levels and functions.
* Structured, organized, pragmatic, and practical working style with strong analytical thinking, problem\-solving skills, and sound decision\-making.
* Full professional English proficiency, including clear written and verbal communication.
* Bottler, manufacturing, consumer goods, or operational technology experience strongly preferred.

**Reporting Line:** Director, Information Technology \- Business \& Product Management

title: MIS Executive
description:
MIS Executive – Warehouse

**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat  
**Department:** Warehouse / Operations  
**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail\-oriented **MIS Executive** to manage warehouse MIS, inventory reporting, stock tracking, and daily operational data for our Ahmedabad warehouse. The candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate warehouse records, preparing reports, coordinating with internal teams, and ensuring timely reporting of stock and operational activities.

Key Responsibilities

* Prepare and maintain **daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports** for warehouse operations.
* Maintain records of **inward, outward, dispatch, stock movement, GRN, and inventory**.
* Track SKU\-wise stock availability, consumption, ageing, and movement.
* Monitor warehouse stock and identify **shortages, excess stock, and discrepancies**.
* Reconcile physical stock with system records and prepare variance reports.
* Maintain and update records of **POs, GRNs, DCs, invoices, and other warehouse documents**.
* Track incoming materials and ensure all inward entries are updated accurately.
* Monitor dispatches and coordinate with the warehouse team for timely documentation and closure.
* Prepare reports related to **machine/product requirements, stock consumption, and replenishment**.
* Coordinate with Procurement, Operations, Finance, and warehouse teams for stock\-related requirements.
* Maintain daily warehouse productivity and operational reports.
* Follow up on pending GRNs, dispatches, stock adjustments, and other open items.
* Analyse warehouse data and highlight important discrepancies or operational gaps to the reporting manager.
* Ensure all MIS reports are accurate and submitted within the defined timelines.
* Support the warehouse team during **stock audits and physical inventory verification**.
* Perform other MIS and reporting activities assigned by the manager.

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of **MS Excel** – Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIF/SUMIFS, COUNTIF/COUNTIFS, filters, sorting, etc.
* Good understanding of **MIS and inventory reporting**.
* Basic knowledge of warehouse operations and stock management.
* Strong analytical and numerical skills.
* Good attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good coordination and communication skills.
* Ability to work with large amounts of data and meet deadlines.
* ERP/Warehouse Management System experience will be an added advantage.

Qualification

* Graduate in B.Com, BBA, B.Sc., or any relevant field.
* Experience in **MIS, warehouse, inventory, logistics, FMCG, retail, or operations** will be preferred.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

title: Senior Manager Product Design & Development
description:
**Position**: Manager / Sr Manager – Product Design \& Development

**Location**: Ahmedabad, Gujarat (Location may change based on business needs)

**Company**: Reputed Infra \& RE company with 3000\+ employee strength

**Department**: Green Energy Division

**About Patel Infrastructure ​**

​Patel Infrastructure Limited (PIL) brings more than 5\+ decades of experience in the infrastructure sector and has built a strong execution track record across 5\+business verticals. Each of these verticals has an average annual turnover of \~INR 3,000 crore, reflecting the company’s scale, financial strength, and capability to execute large and complex infrastructure projects.​

​

Patel Greentech is subsidiary company of PIL, currently executing 0\.70 GW Solar and 1\.3 GWh BESS and 0\.20 GW Wind projects and has a planned rollout of 3 GW Renewable Energy and 5 GWh BESS over the next three years. Our focus is on reliable, cost\-optimized, and sustainable power solutions for energy\-intensive industries.

**Position Overview:**

The Product Design \& Development Manager will own and execute the complete product development lifecycle for LV, MV, HV and specialty power cables from concept definition, design and prototyping through testing, validation, customer approval and commercialisation.

The role will ensure that products are technically compliant, cost\-effective, manufacturable and aligned with customer, application and market requirements. The position requires strong ownership, hands\-on technical decision\-making, execution focus, innovation and effective team leadership.

**Organization Chart:** 

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Product Development and Innovation**

* Lead end\-to\-end development of LV, MV, HV and specialty cable products.
* Own the product development roadmap and technical strategy for the power cable portfolio, including prioritization of new products based on customer requirements, market opportunities, technical feasibility and commercial potential.
* Develop solutions for solar, BESS, wind, power transmission and distribution, industrial and infrastructure applications.
* Convert customer, market and application requirements into practical cable designs.
* Develop new cable constructions, sizes, materials and application\-specific solutions.
* Identify innovative concepts and convert them into technically feasible, tested and commercially viable products.
* Maintain and improve the existing product portfolio through standardisation, value engineering and continuous improvement.

**2\. Cable Design and Engineering**

* Prepare, review and approve cable constructions, material selections and design parameters.
* Perform or verify calculations for current\-carrying capacity, voltage drop, short\-circuit performance, thermal requirements and mechanical performance.
* Optimise conductor, insulation, screen, armour and sheath construction.
* Drive product cost optimisation through design\-to\-cost, material optimisation, standardisation, alternate material evaluation and value engineering while maintaining required performance and reliability.
* Ensure designs are compatible with available manufacturing processes, equipment and tooling.
* Ensure compliance with applicable IS, IEC, utility and customer specifications.

**3\. Techno\-Commercial Development**

* Prepare and verify BOMs, material consumption statements and product cost estimates.
* Evaluate the technical and commercial feasibility of proposed products.
* Optimise material usage and product cost without compromising performance or reliability.
* Evaluate alternative materials and suppliers in coordination with Procurement.
* Provide technical inputs for target costing, pricing and commercial proposals.

**4\. Prototype, Testing and Validation**

* Plan and coordinate prototype development, sample preparation and production trials.
* Coordinate type, routine and other applicable product testing.
* Review test results and implement necessary design changes.
* Prepare validation plans, test requirements and qualification documentation.
* Coordinate customer, consultant, utility and product approvals.

**5\. Product Certification \& Approvals**

* Lead and coordinate product certification, qualification and approval activities for new and modified cable products.
* Identify applicable IS, IEC, BIS, utility, customer and other national/international certification requirements based on product type and application.
* Develop certification and testing plans, including identification of applicable type tests, special tests, routine tests and third\-party certification requirements.
* Coordinate with BIS, CPRI, ERDA, NABL\-accredited laboratories, certification bodies, utilities and other relevant agencies for product testing, certification and approvals.
* Ensure timely completion and renewal of product certifications, licences, approvals and test certificates.

**6\. Manufacturing and Industrialisation Support**

* Ensure new products are production\-ready and manufacturable.
* Coordinate with Manufacturing on trials, tooling, process requirements and equipment capability.
* Resolve design\-related production issues and support root\-cause analysis.
* Implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure successful transfer of approved products to regular production.

**7\. Supplier, Vendor and Factory Visits**

* Visit supplier, vendor, manufacturing, testing and customer facilities as required.
* Evaluate supplier capabilities, manufacturing processes, quality systems, testing facilities and capacity.
* Coordinate supplier trials, sample development, technical evaluations and corrective actions.
* Support supplier qualification and performance improvement with Procurement and Quality teams.
* Prepare factory visit reports and monitor agreed improvement actions.
* Regular travel is required for audits, technical discussions, trials, inspections, testing, troubleshooting and product approvals.

**8\. Customer and Technical Support**

* Review customer specifications, tender requirements and application conditions.
* Provide technical support to Sales and Business Development teams.
* Participate in customer, consultant and utility discussions when required.
* Evaluate customised cable requirements and recommend suitable solutions.
* Support technical submissions, product approvals and customer clarifications.

**9\. Documentation and Design Control**

* Prepare and maintain product specifications, cable construction drawings, design calculations, BOMs, technical datasheets, cost sheets, test requirements and validation reports.
* Maintain design revisions, change records and approval status.
* Ensure controlled release of approved designs and technical documents.
* Maintain traceability of design changes, test results and customer approvals.

**10\. Team and Project Leadership**

* Lead, guide and develop Product Development and Design Engineers.
* Plan NPD activities, resources, trials and development timelines.
* Monitor project milestones, risks, dependencies and action items.
* Coordinate with Manufacturing, Quality, Procurement, Sales and Commercial teams.
* Report development status, technical issues, risks and corrective actions to management.
* Build technical capability within the team through coaching, reviews and knowledge sharing.
* Promote accountability, timely execution and effective decision\-making.

**Qualifications**

**Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or electrical \& Electronics Engineering.
* Master’s degree in electrical engineering, Cable Technology, Materials Engineering, Product Development, or a related field will be an added advantage.
* 8–12 years of relevant experience in LV/MV/HV power cable design, product development, R\&D or cable manufacturing, With Strong Exposure to power cable design and new product development and industrialisation.
* Experience in solar, BESS, wind, specialty cables or renewable\-energy applications will be an advantage.
* Experience in supplier evaluation, factory visits, testing, production trials and product industrialisation.

**Key Competencies**

* Successful development and launch of new power cable products.
* Accurate, compliant and production\-ready cable designs.
* Timely completion of prototypes, testing and validation.
* Accurate BOMs, material consumption data and product costing.
* Cost\-optimised and standardised cable constructions.
* Successful production trials and industrialisation.
* Timely customer, consultant and utility approvals.
* Effective resolution of design, supplier and manufacturing issues.
* Complete and controlled NPD documentation.
* Successful implementation of innovative product concepts.

**Interested candidates may send their CV to**

Email: sonali.sharma@patelinfra.com

Pay: ₹1,500,000\.00 \- ₹2,000,000\.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* How many years of hands\-on experience do you have in LV/MV/HV power cable design or product development?
* Have you independently developed a power cable product from concept/design through prototype, testing and production industrialisation?
* Which standards/testing/certification activities have you handled?

Work Location: In person
